'''Shommox''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] merchant and a citizen of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She worked at a shop selling various goods in the [[Kaas City]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].
